title: The Long Fall of Constantinople
dek: Of how the city that held for a thousand years was first emptied by its friends, and only then taken by its enemy.

panels.label: Chroniclers Tell It
panels.text: The city fell to a great sultan and a great cannon on 29 May 1453, after a heroic last stand.
